name: Watermelon
summary: Design ecosystem for startups: an open-source React UI library plus a design studio, with mobile, showcase and AI products in the works.
description: Watermelon bundles five products: Studio (a design agency doing product design, UX audits and branding), UI (an open-source React component library built with Tailwind CSS and shadcn conventions — 500+ components, blocks, dashboards, animated components and templates you copy or install with the shadcn CLI), Native (mobile components, launching soon), Showcase (design inspiration, launching soon) and AI (an orchestration layer in development).
contains: blocks: hero, features, pricing, testimonials, FAQ, CTA, footer, navbar, stats, team, 404, contact
install with the shadcn CLI or copy the code, MIT licensed
MCP server and read-only JSON API for agents (800+ catalog examples)
ecosystem: design studio, mobile UI (soon), showcase (soon), AI platform (in development)
